# Test that a configured schema directory produces an inline bundle
# payload the client script can consume for tooltips.

md2html -html output -html-ext html -jsonspec testsite/jsonspec testsite
exists output/README.html

# Bundle is embedded as an inline JSON payload.
grep 'id="md-jsonspec-schemas"' output/README.html
grep '"hypothesis"' output/README.html
grep '"strategy_tag"' output/README.html

# Field metadata survives the bundle projection: enum values and the
# required flag both reach the client.
grep '"local_search"' output/README.html
grep '"required":true' output/README.html

# Client script is wired in.
grep 'js/jsonspec.js' output/README.html
grep 'enrichBlock' output/js/jsonspec.js

# Wrapper div still present so the script has something to find.
grep 'class="md-jsonspec" data-schema-type="hypothesis"' output/README.html

rm -rf testsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# ASCF Hypothesis

```json
{
  "type": "ascf/hypothesis",
  "id": "h1",
  "strategy_tag": "local_search"
}
```

-- testsite/jsonspec/jsonspec.json --
{
  "prefixes": ["ascf/"],
  "badge_url": "schemas.html#%s"
}

-- testsite/jsonspec/hypothesis.schema.json --
{
  "$id": "https://ascf.dev/schema/0.2/hypothesis.schema.json",
  "title": "Hypothesis",
  "description": "A structured proposal for what an island will try next.",
  "required": ["type", "id", "strategy_tag"],
  "properties": {
    "type": {"const": "ascf/hypothesis"},
    "id": {"type": "string", "description": "Unique identifier."},
    "strategy_tag": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The search strategy family.",
      "enum": ["local_search", "crossover", "mutation"]
    }
  }
}
